topology: IPv6-only three-router area0 P2P triangle with PC1 behind R1, PC2 behind R2 and HTTP SRV1 behind R3. Direct R1–R3 transit cost5 plus LAN1 gives service cost6; backup via R2 costs21. PC2 service path costs11. R1 Gi0/2 starts in area1 while R3 stays in area0, so successful backup traffic masks the failed primary adjacency.
implemented: Nineteenth ENARSI Layer3 Technologies entry, independent practice/reference documents, six-row IPv6/link-local addressing plan, staged guide, executable reference and verification commands and current-origin/path/query permalinks. Existing layout, artwork and terminal styling are preserved.

IPv6-only interfaces and scoped host default routes use explicit FE80::1/2/3 gateways. IPv6 unicast routing, dotted-decimal router IDs, passive LANs and P2P transits are checked. Router advertisements are suppressed on the supplied static host LANs. Router static routes and IPv4 shortcuts cannot satisfy intended policy.

Initial diagnosis requires three delivered requests and parent-linked replies in four host/server directions, including actual cost21 backup forwarding for PC1 and independent cost11 PC2 controls. Area0 repair must restore the direct Full pair and cost6 routes in both service directions.

Six live checks require intended interface/process policy, all three Full P2P pairs, three received router advertisements and their IPv6 LAN-prefix data, intra-area O routes at AD110 with exact link-local next hops and interface scope, healthy HTTP service and saved router configs. IOS database views retain separate router/link/intra-area-prefix headings rather than printing IPv4 stub networks in Router-LSAs.

Four-way fresh ICMPv6 delivery and a complete actual HTTP200 response from http://[2001:db8:30::10]/ are graded. Echo evidence requires IPv6 and ICMPV6 identity, accepted requests, matched parent-linked replies and the intended router egresses.

Six controlled exercises cover one-sided Hello5/Dead20 mismatch, passive primary transit, instance1 versus instance0, local MTU1400 negotiation, withdrawn server-LAN /64 and local cost30 asymmetry. Each requires actual changed-state traffic plus fresh restored four-way traffic; config-only toggles, port shutdown and server power substitutes cannot earn the exercises.

MTU1400 on R1 produces actual local ExStart and database-description MTU diagnostics while reciprocal routes use R2 at21; restoring MTU1500 restores the intended direct pair. The modeled peer display may remain asymmetric; complete bilateral RFC timing/state equivalence is not claimed.

LAN withdrawal retains all Full transits but removes remote service routes. Both PCs must experience No route drops while bidirectional PC1/PC2 control succeeds. Cost30 retains all Full pairs but requires actual forward R1–R2–R3 requests at21 and reverse R3–R1 requests at6, plus independent PC2 controls.

The existing engine already delivered and compared OSPFv3 instance IDs. CLI activation now accepts optional instance0–255, validates arguments before mutation, resets omitted/zero values to default, supplies question-mark/Tab help, removes instance state with activation and renders nondefault instances into IOS configs. Real nondefault matching peers, mismatched backup behavior, file replay and saved reload are tested.

Six live and nine historical goals produce practice0/15, diagnosis1/15, baseline9/15 and full15/15. Per-attempt config/route epochs reject stale traffic. Portable YAML retains earned observations but drops runtime, while a new attempt starts fresh and a reference starts with six live goals only.
scope: Classic IOS IPv6 OSPFv3 single-area troubleshooting, selected using ipv6 router ospf and ipv6 ospf interface commands. Optional legacy per-interface instance selection is complete through CLI, rendering and the existing delivered-packet engine. Multiple simultaneous processes/instances on a single interface, IPsec/authentication trailers, wire-format interoperability, complete RFC state/timing equivalence, fresh CML captures, multi-area filtering, duplicate-router-ID incidents and OSPFv3 IPv4 address-family exercises are not claimed.
